notes:
Account snapshot:
- Company: Nimbus Relay Systems — mid-market SaaS (product analytics + user insights). Looking to add LLM features: product-facing chat assistant for power users, semantic embeddings for search across release notes/KB, and reranking for recommendations.
- Volume/targets: estimated 15–25M tokens/month during steady state; burst to 50M during big releases. Chat latency target p50 150–300ms, p95 <800ms. Reranking throughput ~8–12 qps for recommendation pipelines. Cost sensitive: want clear unit economics to price new premium tier.
Recent timeline (short bullets):
- 2026-01-14: Intro demo (Hosted API) — AE Samira + SE Diego. Good product fit; PM liked streaming responses.
- 2026-02-01: POC kickoff — seeded dataset, baseline hosted integration, instrumentation enabled (token billing + latency metrics).
- 2026-02-18: Security questionnaire submitted (SAML, SOC2 ask). CISO call scheduled.
- 2026-02-25: Requested Dedicated pricing and committed throughput SLA for 99.9 uptime.
- 2026-03-01: Cost optimization workshop (Redwood Optimize + SE) — batching/caching/quantization deep dive.
POC scope and findings so far (POC is 4 wks):
- Phase 1: baseline hosted tests w/ open 13B model for chat + embeddings.
- Phase 2: Canary on Dedicated (2xA100 equiv) to validate latency and throughput.
- Phase 3: Cost workshop => implement batching heuristics, prefix/KV caching for repeated context, and quantization profiles for reranking model.
Early bench outcomes (internal notes):
- Batching: tuned request sizing per route — reduced per-token inference cost ~22% on reranking flows (measured in tokens/sec efficiency).
- KV/prefix caching: search flow with repeated context saw approx 35% reduction in token consumption for common queries.
- Quantization: int8 profile for reranking yielded 2–3x throughput increase with ~1–2% NDCG drop in offline tests. Customer flagged quality threshold but open to A/B.
Customer quotes / voice of customer:
- Head of Product: "Need predictable unit economics before we commit to a paid tier — show cost per DAU and per-request delta."
- Engineering lead: "If Dedicated gives steady latency and cost drop, procurement can move fast, but CISO wants residency + KMS controls."
Open items / blockers:
- Legal: finalize DPA and data residency appendix (EU customers).
- Security: SAML integration and SOC2 attestation needed for procurement.
- Pricing: need final Dedicated committed price + burst pricing table to model ARR.
Next steps (near term):
- 2026-03-08: follow-up workshop to run full quantized Dedicated bench and produce unit economics workbook (owner: SE Diego).
- Deliver updated pricing proposal after bench (owner: AE Samira).
- CISO review + KMS integration plan (owner: Customer security lead).
Stubs/refs: pricing deck (drive link above), security FAQ in drive, Fireflies meeting ids for transcriptions.
Notes style: shorthand CRM entries, action-oriented.
